disclosed_flaws: All six hook windows (the 'stuffed tonight' lyric) are wordless event covers, not mouth-sung — the generator refused that sung lyric three times; covers are flagged in GATE_LOG.md and CUTLIST.md.
Word-sync is anchored on take-ASR word times; visible mouth events may lag song onsets by a few tenths of a second on some lines. No phoneme-accurate lipsync is claimed.
Grey-zone smooth warps on S03 (k=0.794), S04 (k=0.767) and S22 t2 (k=1.286) — exact words, strong motion, disclosed in GATE_LOG.
S25's final line ends ~1.1s after the song's line end, resolving into the wordless outro tail.
S19's take chants 'So proud' three times across the song's two chant lines; the extra chant reads as in-line mouth motion on the held second line.
S07's Freeze event reads as a posed family rather than a hard freeze; S06's appliance choreography reads mainly through the wife's cooking action.
S01 husband's sweater reads a darker burgundy than the reference still; S11 has a faint illegible blurred wall sign in the background.
